'''2022 MPC Jeffrey Johns LS LTWWv Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeffrey Johns]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Let The Wookiee Win (V) Johns LS.txt |Download]]
